t: India became a republic on 26 January 1950, when the constitution drafted under B.R. Ambedkar came into force.
It has remained a parliamentary democracy, interrupted only by the Emergency of 1975–1977, with regular elections since 1951–1952.
Now the world's most populous country, it is a nuclear power and one of the five largest economies by nominal output.
dyk: The first general election of 1951–1952 had about 173 million voters, most unable to read, so each party was given a symbol, a practice Indian elections still use.
